criteria.criterion: The method treats transcript, recording, metadata, People label, select tree, and visible frame as related but non-interchangeable traces.
People and speaker labels remain retrieval candidates until exact-frame identity and speaking associations receive independent corroboration and human review.
Nested keep depth preserves historical curatorial attention without becoming an objective score, final ranking, or mandate for current publication.
Scene families and earlier asides remain available so a single hero frame cannot erase collective agency, sequence, or quieter forms of work.
Private locators and identity metadata stay outside public Git, while rights, consent, credit, crop, caption, destination, Jamie approval, production, and indexing remain separate human gates.

hard_gates: No People label becomes a public identity assertion without exact-frame human review.
No transcript turn is assigned to a visible person through temporal proximity alone.
No nested keep path becomes an objective quality score or final editorial decision.
No raw label, filename, timestamp, coordinate, album name, source identifier, local path, recording, transcript, contact sheet, or unapproved pixel enters public Git.
No automated or historical selection clears rights, consent, credit, crop, caption, destination, Jamie approval, production, or indexing.
